info.title: bit CLI
info.description: Creates bit platform projects that are ready to run on Windows, macOS and Linux, translates .resx files with an LLM, decodes stack traces minified by Bit.Minifier and writes AOT profiles for Blazor WebAssembly apps.

commands.name: diff
commands.description: Show what changed in bit Boilerplate between two versions: creates the project with each into one git repository, so the second commit is the upgrade.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Create a bit Boilerplate project and get it ready to run: tools, workloads, packages, build, git, migration, trust and IDE.

commands.name: setup
commands.description: Get an existing bit Boilerplate project ready on this machine, e.g. after cloning it or to add the Android app later: tools, workloads, packages and build.
